properties.title: Finsteraarhornhütte SAC
properties.description:
Up to date high mountain cabin, embedded in a vast glacier landscape. Features pleasant multiple occupancy rooms, generous lavatories in the cabin and a magnificent sun terrace. Early reservation is necessary for spring ski mountaineering tours. Small winter hut is open during the short period with no innkeeper. No cell phone reception.
Warning: All access routes cross glaciers. Appropriate experience and equipment, or the guidance of a mountain guide, are required.
